canonical_project: Microsoft Mekaguda/Shadnagar/Chandanvelly data centre campus expansion (incl. three additional ~100MW data centres)
notes: Microsoft acquired land parcels of 22 acres at Mekaguda village, 41 acres at Shadnagar and 52 acres at Chandanvelly (all Ranga Reddy district) for its largest India data centre region; HYD01 (Mekaguda campus) is part of the now-live Azure region. Reports (2025) say Microsoft will add three more ~100MW data centre projects in Telangana. Exact MW per site not disclosed.
